A.title: Letter A
steps: Make a fist (curl all four fingers into your palm).
Rest your thumb against the side of your index finger — not tucked inside the fist.
Face your palm outward (toward the camera / other person).
A.remember: Fist + thumb on the side = A

B.title: Letter B
steps: Hold all four fingers straight up and together (flat hand).
Bend your thumb across your palm.
Palm faces outward.

C.title: Letter C
steps: Curve your whole hand into a C shape.
Thumb and fingers form an open curve (like holding a cup).
Palm faces sideways.
C.remember: Curved hand like the letter C

D.title: Letter D
steps: Point your index finger straight up.
Touch your thumb to the tips of the other three fingers (they form a circle/O).
Palm faces outward.
D.remember: Index up + other fingers touch thumb = D

E.title: Letter E
steps: Curl all four fingertips down toward your palm.
Tuck the thumb against the fingertips (not over the top like S).
Palm faces outward.
E.remember: Fingertips on palm edge, thumb in = E

F.title: Letter F
steps: Touch tip of thumb to tip of index finger (OK shape).
Keep middle, ring, and pinky fingers straight up.
Palm faces outward.
F.remember: OK circle + three fingers up = F

G.title: Letter G
steps: Point index finger sideways (horizontal).
Extend thumb roughly parallel under it.
Curl the other fingers into the palm. Palm faces you / sideways.

H.title: Letter H
steps: Extend index and middle fingers together, pointing sideways.
Thumb holds down the other fingers.
Palm faces you.

I.title: Letter I
steps: Make a fist.
Stick only your pinky finger straight up.
Palm faces outward.

J.title: Letter J
steps: Start like letter I (pinky up).
Draw a J in the air with your pinky (sweep down and hook).
Static practice: hold the I handshape.

K.title: Letter K
steps: Index finger points up.
Middle finger points up/out at an angle (like a V but thumb touches between them).
Thumb tip rests between index and middle at the base. Palm out.
K.remember: K looks like a V with thumb in the middle

L.title: Letter L
steps: Extend index finger straight up.
Extend thumb straight out to the side.
Curl other fingers down. Palm faces outward.
L.remember: Index + thumb make an L shape

M.title: Letter M
steps: Tuck thumb under three fingers (index, middle, ring).
Pinky curls in.
Palm faces down/out — three knuckles show over the thumb.

N.title: Letter N
steps: Tuck thumb under two fingers (index and middle).
Ring and pinky curl in.
Palm faces down/out.

O.title: Letter O
steps: Curve all fingertips to meet the thumb, making a round O.
Like holding a small ball.
Palm faces sideways.
O.remember: Fingers + thumb make an O circle

P.title: Letter P
steps: Form a K handshape.
Point it downward (middle finger aims down).
Palm faces down.

Q.title: Letter Q
steps: Form a G handshape.
Point index and thumb downward.
Palm faces down.

R.title: Letter R
steps: Cross index and middle fingers (like wishing for luck).
Thumb holds the other fingers.
Palm faces outward.

S.title: Letter S
steps: Make a fist.
Wrap the thumb across the front of the fingers (over the knuckles).
Palm faces outward.
S.remember: Fist with thumb over fingers = S (different from A)

T.title: Letter T
steps: Make a fist.
Tuck the thumb between index and middle finger.
Palm faces outward.

U.title: Letter U
steps: Index and middle fingers straight up, pressed together.
Thumb holds ring and pinky down.
Palm faces outward.

V.title: Letter V
steps: Index and middle fingers up in a V (peace sign).
Thumb holds other fingers down.
Palm faces outward.

W.title: Letter W
steps: Index, middle, and ring fingers up and spread.
Thumb holds pinky (or touches pinky).
Palm faces outward.

X.title: Letter X
steps: Make a fist with index finger raised.
Bend/hook the index finger (like a claw).
Palm faces outward.

Y.title: Letter Y
steps: Extend thumb and pinky out (hang-loose / shaka shape).
Curl middle three fingers into the palm.
Palm faces outward.

Z.title: Letter Z
steps: Point with index finger (like D but used for drawing).
Draw a Z in the air: across, diagonal, across.
Static practice: hold index finger ready to write Z.

0.title: Number 0
steps: Same handshape as letter O — fingertips meet thumb in a circle.

1.title: Number 1
steps: Index finger up; other fingers curled (like D without the O circle emphasis).

2.title: Number 2
steps: Index and middle up in a V (same idea as letter V).

3.title: Number 3
steps: Thumb, index, and middle extended; ring and pinky down.

4.title: Number 4
steps: Four fingers up, thumb tucked across palm.

5.title: Number 5
steps: Open hand — all five digits spread, palm out.

6.title: Number 6
steps: Touch thumb tip to pinky tip; other three fingers up.

7.title: Number 7
steps: Touch thumb tip to ring fingertip; other fingers up.

8.title: Number 8
steps: Touch thumb tip to middle fingertip; other fingers up.

9.title: Number 9
steps: Touch thumb tip to index fingertip (like F); other fingers up.
